description: This file defines and registers multiple benchmarking experiments for PyTorch models, including a simple MLP and layer normalization, and includes functions for running benchmarks, outputting results to CSV and JSON, and orchestrating experiment execution.

classes.name: SimpleMLP
classes.description: A simple multi-layer perceptron model with layer normalization and linear layers.

methods.name: run_mlp_layer_norm_gelu
methods.description: Runs a benchmark experiment for an MLP with layer normalization and GELU activation, measuring FLOPS utilization.

methods.name: run_layer_norm
methods.description: Runs a benchmark experiment for layer normalization, measuring memory bandwidth.

methods.name: run_gather_gemv
methods.description: Runs a benchmark for a gather + GEMV operation, measuring memory bandwidth.

methods.name: run_gemv
methods.description: Runs a benchmark for a general matrix-vector multiplication, measuring memory bandwidth.

methods.name: output_csv
methods.description: Outputs benchmark results to a CSV file.

methods.name: output_json
methods.description: Outputs benchmark results to a JSON file for ingestion into a benchmark database.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to execute registered experiments and save results.
